member.name: T:Bezoro.Persistence.AtomicFileSaveStore
member.summary: Stores versioned envelopes using temporary files and same-directory replacement.
member.remarks: Intended for a trusted, application-owned directory on a local filesystem with atomic replacement support. Operations own their streams and may run concurrently; same-process snapshot opens, commits, and deletes for a normalized path share bounded synchronization. The last filesystem commit wins. Atomic visibility is not a guarantee of survival across power loss or failure of a filesystem or storage device.

member.name: M:Bezoro.Persistence.AtomicFileSaveStore.WriteAsync(System.String,System.UInt32,System.ReadOnlyMemory{System.Byte},System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.remarks: Cancellation or failure before replacement preserves an existing save and removes this operation's temporary file. No cancellation check occurs after replacement: a committed write reports success. Checksumming runs on the calling execution context; async I/O does not automatically offload CPU work.

member.name: M:Bezoro.Persistence.AtomicFileSaveStore.DeleteAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.remarks: The slot is removed by a same-directory rename under the path gate. Retired-file cleanup is synchronous. Cancellation is checked before the rename, never after it. Cleanup failure may therefore be reported after removal.
